FILE.ROLE: HTTP server 进程级核心模块：管理会话生命周期、按方法分派请求、协调文件服务与错误响应

DATA.NAME: http_server_t
DATA.ROLE: HTTP server 进程级对象不透明句柄，持有端口、root 目录、TCP server 与会话链表

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: http_server_t* http_server_create(uint16_t port, const char* root_dir)
INTERFACE.NAME: http_server_create
INTERFACE.ROLE: 创建 HTTP server：realpath 解析 root 目录→stat 验证目录存在→strncpy 保存 root→创建 TCP server 并绑定 on_accept/on_event/on_close 回调

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: int http_server_start(http_server_t* server)
INTERFACE.NAME: http_server_start
INTERFACE.ROLE: 委托 http_tcp_server_start 启动底层 TCP server

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: int http_server_run(http_server_t* server)
INTERFACE.NAME: http_server_run
INTERFACE.ROLE: 委托 http_tcp_server_run 进入事件循环

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: void http_server_stop(http_server_t* server)
INTERFACE.NAME: http_server_stop
INTERFACE.ROLE: 委托 http_tcp_server_stop 停止事件循环

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: void http_server_destroy(http_server_t* server)
INTERFACE.NAME: http_server_destroy
INTERFACE.ROLE: 遍历销毁所有活跃会话→停止并销毁 TCP server→释放 server 自身；空指针安全

DATA.NAME: struct http_server
DATA.ROLE: HTTP server 私有状态结构

FIELDS.NAME: tcp
FIELDS.ROLE: 底层 TCP server 句柄

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static http_session_t* find_session(http_server_t* server, int fd)
INTERFACE.NAME: find_session
INTERFACE.ROLE: 在 server 会话链表中按 fd 查找会话

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static void remove_session(http_server_t* server, int fd)
INTERFACE.NAME: remove_session
INTERFACE.ROLE: 从 server 会话链表中按 fd 删除并销毁会话

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static int add_session(http_server_t* server, http_session_t* session)
INTERFACE.NAME: add_session
INTERFACE.ROLE: 将新会话节点头插法加入 server 会话链表

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static int send_error(http_server_t* server, http_session_t* session, int code)
INTERFACE.NAME: send_error
INTERFACE.ROLE: 发送 HTML 错误响应并注册写监听

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static int flush_and_update(http_server_t* server, http_session_t* session)
INTERFACE.NAME: flush_and_update
INTERFACE.ROLE: 刷写连接输出缓冲并根据剩余数据更新 epoll 写监听

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static int serve_file(http_server_t* server, http_session_t* session, const http_request_t* req, bool head_only)
INTERFACE.NAME: serve_file
INTERFACE.ROLE: 核心文件服务函数：resolve_path→stat→文件则读取并发送→目录则优先 index.html 否则列表→不存在则 404

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static int handle_get(http_server_t* server, http_session_t* session, const http_request_t* req)
INTERFACE.NAME: handle_get
INTERFACE.ROLE: GET 请求处理器：委托 serve_file(head_only=false)

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static int handle_head(http_server_t* server, http_session_t* session, const http_request_t* req)
INTERFACE.NAME: handle_head
INTERFACE.ROLE: HEAD 请求处理器：委托 serve_file(head_only=true)，仅发送头部不含正文

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static int handle_post(http_server_t* server, http_session_t* session, const http_request_t* req)
INTERFACE.NAME: handle_post
INTERFACE.ROLE: POST 请求处理器：resolve_path 确定目标→目录返回 405→fopen wb 写入 body→201 Created 响应

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static int dispatch(http_server_t* server, http_session_t* session, const http_request_t* req)
INTERFACE.NAME: dispatch
INTERFACE.ROLE: 按请求方法分发到对应处理器：GET→handle_get, HEAD→handle_head, POST→handle_post, UNKNOWN→501

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static void on_accept_cb(void* user, int fd, const struct sockaddr_storage* peer, socklen_t peer_len)
INTERFACE.NAME: on_accept_cb
INTERFACE.ROLE: TCP server 新连接回调：创建会话→加入链表→失败则关闭客户端

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static void close_client(http_server_t* server, int fd)
INTERFACE.NAME: close_client
INTERFACE.ROLE: 关闭客户端连接：委托 http_tcp_server_close_client 关闭 fd 并清理

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static void on_event_cb(void* user, int fd, uint32_t events)
INTERFACE.NAME: on_event_cb
INTERFACE.ROLE: TCP server 数据/写就绪事件回调：按事件类型分发到读/写/关闭处理

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static void on_close_cb(void* user, int fd)
INTERFACE.NAME: on_close_cb
INTERFACE.ROLE: TCP server 连接关闭回调：从 server 链表移除会话

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: http_server_t* http_server_create(uint16_t port, const char* root_dir)
INTERFACE.NAME: http_server_create
INTERFACE.ROLE: 创建 HTTP server：realpath 解析 root→stat 验证目录→保存 root→创建 TCP server 并绑定回调

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: int http_server_start(http_server_t* server)
INTERFACE.NAME: http_server_start
INTERFACE.ROLE: 委托 http_tcp_server_start 启动底层 TCP server

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: int http_server_run(http_server_t* server)
INTERFACE.NAME: http_server_run
INTERFACE.ROLE: 委托 http_tcp_server_run 进入事件循环

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: void http_server_stop(http_server_t* server)
INTERFACE.NAME: http_server_stop
INTERFACE.ROLE: 委托 http_tcp_server_stop 停止事件循环

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: void http_server_destroy(http_server_t* server)
INTERFACE.NAME: http_server_destroy
INTERFACE.ROLE: 遍历销毁所有活跃会话→停止并销毁 TCP server→释放 server；空指针安全
